component.name: Provenance: Elite Force II
component.summary: An unofficial native port of Star Trek: Elite Force II

description.p: ProvenanceEF2 is an unofficial, non-commercial project that runs Star Trek: Elite Force II (2003, developed by Ritual Entertainment and published by Activision) natively on modern platforms.

The engine is the id Tech 3 lineage through OpenMoHAA, under the GNU GPL v2 or later. The game layer derives from the Ritual Elite Force II SDK under its limited-use agreement and, where the publisher released no source, from the retail binaries; those parts are not covered by the GPL. The two regimes cannot govern one file, so no single licence covers the tree. The project ships no game assets: it reads the operator's own retail installation.
